metadata.description: First-party hosted MCP connectors for AutoFire, UniPost and Calorie Cub.

plugins.name: autofire
plugins.description: Read one car dealership's inventory, lead workflow, test drives, follow-up priorities, and daily insights through AutoFire's hosted MCP server at mcp.goautofire.com. Sign in with an AutoFire account on first connect.

plugins.name: unipost
plugins.description: Schedule posts to LinkedIn profiles, X, TikTok, and YouTube, and see how published posts performed, through UniPost's hosted MCP at mcp.unipost.ai. Sign in with a UniPost account on first connect.

plugins.name: calorie-cub
plugins.description: Log meals, check calories and macros, save private recipes, and track weight in your Calorie Cub diary through its hosted MCP server. OAuth sign-in required.
